profileLabel: Mildly left economics; weakly liberal social values; institution-supporting (low-medium confidence)
summary: La Union 1st District representative with 70 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps expansion, an electricity lifeline rate, a Magna Carta for health workers, adolescent pregnancy prevention, extrajudicial killing as a heinous crime, civil forfeiture of unlawfully acquired foreign properties, a ban on fast-paced online gambling, violence against women in politics, an anti-dynasty ban and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Social score nets a vice-regulation bill against gender and reproductive-health bills. Extrajudicial killing is a single civil-liberties issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps expansion and an electricity lifeline rate for wage earners (-2 to -3) and a Magna Carta for health workers (-2), against travel tax abolition (+1).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08647, HB08191, HB01661, HB08464 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored adolescent pregnancy prevention (+3, reproductive health) and violence against women in politics (+3, gender), against a ban on fast-paced online gambling (-2, vice regulation).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01212, HB08393, HB01643 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored an anti-dynasty ban (+3) and civil forfeiture of unlawfully acquired properties (+2, anti-corruption). Two issues, bills only.
